review_evidence: README identifies this as the Lean 4 implementation of the LOST-POP compound memory model associated with the PLDI 2023 Compound Memory Models work.
The source encodes operational memory-model states, requests, scopes, constraints, litmus tests, and exploration behavior for architectures including PTX, TSO, and compound models.

Source inspection finds formal consistency/coherence theorems such as emptyArrayCoherent, RequestArrayInsertConsistent, and emptyCoherent, so the repository contains specification and proof prior art, not merely an executable driver.
summary: Retain lost-pop-lean as a formal operational compound-memory-model implementation with coherence invariants and architecture semantics.
